title: Waves as a table: shares as a dim column, wave header rules, Lineup column only after ticking

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Frontend design review of 2026-10-25 (opus, from four owner screenshots; it did not read docs/dashboard.md or adj 149, so check the spec first). In the Waves view the (shares: S65 internal/engine/r... tails clip off the right edge on most rows and the view reads as a wall of text; the Lineup heading sits over nothing until something is ticked. Make shares a dim column holding only the predecessor id (e.g. <S65) with the shared file shown in the item pane on Enter, draw wave headers as rules (-- wave 2 --- 4 items), and show the Lineup column only after something is ticked.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestSharesIsADimColumnWithThePredecessorIdOnly.
- TestEnterOnAWavesRowShowsTheSharedFiles.
- TestWaveHeadersAreRulesWithCounts.
- TestLineupColumnAppearsOnlyAfterTicking.
- TestWavesRowsNeverClipTheKeyColumns at 100x30 and 80x24.
- Golden views, colour and monochrome.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Tests first. 2. Build the table columns. 3. The item pane on Enter. 4. Wave rules. 5. Docs and goldens. UI slice: UI pass (r14). The Enter pane for a Waves row is new; keep it read-only.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
- adj lint
- [HUMAN CHECK] The owner looks at the changed view in a live terminal at 100x30 and 80x24.
